related.reason_vi: Năm chiến lược đọc ghi được bài nguồn liệt kê lại ở đây.
Các chính sách đẩy khóa ra khi bộ nhớ đệm đầy.
Khởi động nguội và nhiều khóa cùng hết hạn là các kiểu bộ nhớ đệm hỏng.

claims.claim_vi: Cache data that is read frequently but modified infrequently; caching is less useful for dynamic data; treat the cache as transient and keep important data in the persistent store; in highly scalable scenarios the cache can be seeded to reduce load on the data store at peak times.
claims.section: Decide when to cache data; Determine how to cache data effectively

claims.claim_vi: Redis 7.0.15, allkeys-lru, 10,000 keys with Zipf access, 1000-byte values, 60,000 cache-aside reads: maxmemory 2mb hit 63% (21,024 evicted, 1,032 keys left), 4mb 79% (9,620; 2,951), 8mb 88% (549; 6,805), 16mb 88% (0; 7,298). Uniform access over 10,000 keys at 4mb: 29%. noeviction at 4mb: hit 80% with 8,981 SETs rejected with an OOM error.
claims.verified_by: Experiment run by the author on 2026-10-18 on one KVM virtual machine (4 vCPU): raw RESP client in Python, Zipf distribution with exponent 1, hit ratio from INFO keyspace_hits/keyspace_misses.

claims.claim_vi: Five groups to consider: suitable scenarios, caching techniques, eviction algorithms, key metrics, other issues (thundering herd on cold start, TTL).

design_notes_vi: Ba khung ghi chú: khi nào đáng dùng, đo gì, và phép thử thêm bộ nhớ. Bảng số đo đầy đủ nằm trong bài.
source_deviations: Source lists five groups without explanation; the lesson keeps three questions and adds a measurement showing diminishing returns of more memory and the hidden write errors of noeviction.
Caching techniques and eviction algorithms are left to their own lessons in the group.

The check question reads evicted_keys only after the policy: under noeviction (or volatile-* with no expiring keys) it stays 0 while writes are rejected, and as a cumulative counter its change over an interval matters, not its raw value.
The remaining first-request misses are unavoidable only for the experiment's empty, lazily filled cache; the lesson notes that seeding before traffic avoids them.
